entities.name: Alwin
entities.description: Bishop of the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad, cautious and hesitant to escalate the crisis in Thraben.

entities.name: Lieutenant Traken
entities.description: Warned Alwin about zombie infestations and Grimgrin.

entities.name: Grimgrin
entities.description: Specific threat in the zombie infestations.

entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: Lunarch murdered when the city was overrun.

entities.name: Lothar
entities.description: Guardian of Thraben who threw himself off the walls.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: New Guardian of Thraben who foiled Geralf and Gisa.

events.summary: Alwin receives warnings from Lieutenant Traken but remains skeptical and reluctant to inform the Lunarch.
events.quote: Alwin remained skeptical and reluctant to escalate the matter to the Lunarch without further proof

events.summary: Thraben is overrun, the Lunarch Mikaeus Cecani is murdered and Lothar throws himself off the walls.
events.quote: the Lunarch Mikaeus Cecani was murdered

events.summary: Geralf and Gisa almost conquer the city, foiled by Thalia.
events.quote: only foiled by the quick thinking of the new Guardian of Thraben, Thalia

relations.quote: Alwin is a bishop of the Church of Avacyn on the plane of Innistrad
